name: vscode-git-graph
description: View a Git Graph of your repository, and perform Git actions from the graph. Community-maintained MIT fork of Git Graph.

git-graph.commitDetailsView.autoCenter.description: Automatically center the commit details view when it is opened.

git-graph.commitDetailsView.fileView.fil.description: In the file tree, show a folder that only contains one other folder on one line, for example "src/web/graph".

enumDescriptions: Show the changed files as a tree of folders
Show the changed files as a flat list with their paths
git-graph.commitDetailsView.fileView.typ.description: Default view of the changed files in the Commit Details View. The view can be switched with the buttons above the files.

git-graph.contextMenuActionsVisibility.description: Hide individual actions from the context menus. Every action is visible unless it is set to false here, for example {"commit": {"reset": false}}.

branch.description: Actions in the context menu of a local branch label.

rebase.description: Rebase current branch on this branch

commit.description: Actions in the context menu of a commit.

reset.description: Reset current branch to this Commit

rebase.description: Rebase current branch on this Commit

remoteBranch.description: Actions in the context menu of a remote branch label.

tag.description: Actions in the context menu of a tag label.

uncommittedChanges.description: Actions in the context menu of the "Uncommitted Changes" row.

stash.description: Actions in the context menu of a stash.

enumDescriptions: Show the date and time, for example "19 Mar 2019 21:34"
Show the date only, for example "19 Mar 2019"
Show relative times, for example "5 minutes ago"
git-graph.date.format.description: Specifies the date format to be used in the date column of Git Graph.

enumDescriptions: Use the author date of a commit
Use the committer date of a commit
git-graph.date.type.description: Specifies the date type to be displayed throughout Git Graph.

git-graph.defaultColumnVisibility.description: Default visibility of the Date, Author and Commit columns. Right-click a column header to change the visibility for one repository.

git-graph.dialog.addTag.type.description: Default tag type in the "Add Tag" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.applyStash.reinstateInd.description: Default state of the "Reinstate Index" checkbox in the "Apply Stash" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.cherryPick.noCommit.description: Default state of the "No Commit" checkbox in the "Cherry Pick" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.cherryPick.recordOrigin.description: Default state of the "Record Origin" checkbox in the "Cherry Pick" dialog (adds a "cherry picked from commit" line to the message).

git-graph.dialog.createBranch.checkOut.description: Default state of the "Check out" checkbox in the "Create Branch" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.deleteBranch.forceDelet.description: Default state of the "Force Delete" checkbox in the "Delete Branch" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.fetchIntoLocalBranch.fo.description: Default state of the "Force Fetch" checkbox in the "Fetch into Local Branch" dialog.

enumDescriptions: Spaces are left as typed (git rejects reference names that contain spaces)
Spaces are replaced with hyphens (-)
Spaces are replaced with underscores (_)
git-graph.dialog.general.referenceInputS.description: Replace spaces typed into branch and tag name inputs with another character.

git-graph.dialog.merge.noCommit.description: Default state of the "No Commit" checkbox in the merge dialogs.

git-graph.dialog.merge.noFastForward.description: Default state of the "Create a new commit even if fast-forward is possible" checkbox in the merge dialogs.

git-graph.dialog.merge.squashCommits.description: Default state of the "Squash Commits" checkbox in the merge dialogs.

enumDescriptions: Use "Merge branch '<name>'" (or "Merge commit '<hash>'") as the message of the squash commit
Use the message that git prepares in .git/SQUASH_MSG, which lists the squashed commits
git-graph.dialog.merge.squashMessageForm.description: Message of the commit that a squash merge creates.

git-graph.dialog.popStash.reinstateIndex.description: Default state of the "Reinstate Index" checkbox in the "Pop Stash" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.pullBranch.noFastForwar.description: Default state of the "Create a new commit even if fast-forward is possible" checkbox in the "Pull Branch" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.pullBranch.squashCommit.description: Default state of the "Squash Commits" checkbox in the "Pull Branch" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.rebase.ignoreDate.description: Default state of the "Ignore Date" checkbox in the "Rebase" dialogs (use the current time as the committer date of the rebased commits).

enumDescriptions: Keep all changes, but reset head
Keep working tree, but reset index
Discard all changes
git-graph.dialog.resetCurrentBranchToCom.description: Default reset mode in the "Reset current branch to this Commit" dialog.

enumDescriptions: Keep working tree, but reset index
Discard all changes
git-graph.dialog.resetUncommittedChanges.description: Default reset mode in the "Reset uncommitted changes" dialog.

git-graph.dialog.stashUncommittedChanges.description: Default state of the "Include Untracked" checkbox in the "Stash uncommitted changes" dialog.

git-graph.graph.colours.description: Specifies the colours used on the graph.

enumDescriptions: Use smooth curves when transitioning between branches on the graph
Use angular lines when transitioning between branches on the graph
git-graph.graph.style.description: Specifies the style of the graph.

git-graph.keyboardShortcut.find.description: Letter of the keyboard shortcut that opens the find widget. It is pressed together with Ctrl (Windows, Linux) or Cmd (macOS) while the Git Graph view has focus.

git-graph.keyboardShortcut.refresh.description: Letter of the Ctrl/Cmd shortcut that refreshes the view.

git-graph.keyboardShortcut.scrollToHead.description: Letter of the Ctrl/Cmd shortcut that scrolls to the checked-out commit.

git-graph.keyboardShortcut.scrollToStash.description: Letter of the Ctrl/Cmd shortcut that scrolls to the next stash (Shift to go to the previous one).

git-graph.maxDepthOfRepoSearch.description: Specifies the maximum depth of subfolders to search when discovering repositories in the workspace.

git-graph.repository.commits.fetchAvatar.description: Fetch avatars of commit authors and committers. By enabling this setting, you consent to commit author and committer email addresses being sent GitHub, GitLab or Gravatar, depending on the repositories remote origin.

git-graph.repository.commits.initialLoad.description: Specifies the number of commits to initially load.

git-graph.repository.commits.loadMore.description: Specifies the number of commits to load when the "Load More Commits" button is pressed (only shown when more commits are available).

git-graph.repository.commits.loadMoreAut.description: Load more commits automatically when the view is scrolled to the bottom, instead of waiting for the "Load More Commits" button.

git-graph.repository.commits.mute.commit.description: Show commits that are not ancestors of the checked-out commit with a muted text colour.

git-graph.repository.commits.mute.mergeC.description: Show merge commits with a muted text colour.

enumDescriptions: Commits are shown in commit timestamp order, with parents always after their children
Commits are shown in author timestamp order, with parents always after their children
Commits are shown in topological order: no parent is shown before all of its children, and commits on the same line of history stay together
git-graph.repository.commits.order.description: Specifies the order of commits on the graph. See the --date-order, --author-date-order and --topo-order options of "git log".

git-graph.repository.fetchAndPrune.description: Before fetching from the remote(s) with the Fetch button, remove any remote-tracking references that no longer exist on the remote(s).

git-graph.repository.fetchAndPruneTags.description: Before fetching from the remote(s) with the Fetch button, remove any local tags that no longer exist on the remote(s). Requires git 2.17 or later and "git-graph.repository.fetchAndPrune".

git-graph.repository.includeCommitsMenti.description: When "Show All" is selected, also include commits that are only mentioned by reflogs (git log --reflog).

git-graph.repository.onLoad.scrollToHead.description: Scroll to the checked-out commit when a repository is loaded.

git-graph.repository.onLoad.showCheckedO.description: Show the current branch by default when Git Graph is opened. Default: false (show all branches)

git-graph.repository.onlyFollowFirstPare.description: Only follow the first parent of commits when loading them (git log --first-parent). Hides the commits that were merged in.

git-graph.repository.showCommitsOnlyRefe.description: Show commits that are only referenced by tags when "Show All" is selected.

git-graph.repository.showRemoteBranches.description: Default state of the "Show Remote Branches" checkbox when a repository is opened.

git-graph.repository.showRemoteHeads.description: Show remote HEAD symbolic references, for example "origin/HEAD", on the graph.

git-graph.repository.showStashes.description: Show stashes on the graph. Each stash appears as a row above the commit it was created from.

git-graph.repository.showUncommittedChan.description: Show uncommitted changes (set to false to decrease load time on large repositories).

git-graph.repository.showUntrackedFiles.description: Count untracked files in the "Uncommitted Changes" row. Set to false to speed up loading in repositories with many untracked files.

git-graph.repository.sign.commits.description: Sign the commits that Git Graph creates (merge, cherry pick, revert, squash) with GPG or X.509, using the signing key of your git configuration.

git-graph.repository.sign.tags.description: Sign the annotated tags that Git Graph creates with GPG or X.509, using the signing key of your git configuration.

git-graph.repository.useMailmap.description: Apply the .mailmap file of the repository to author and committer names and email addresses.

git-graph.retainContextWhenHidden.description: Keep the Git Graph view alive while its tab is hidden, so that it restores instantly. Uses more memory. When false, the view is rebuilt when the tab becomes visible again.

git-graph.showStatusBarItem.description: Show a Status Bar item which opens Git Graph when clicked.

enumDescriptions: Show a colour icon which suits most Visual Studio Code colour themes
Show a grey icon which suits Visual Studio Code colour themes that are predominantly grayscale
git-graph.tabIconColourTheme.description: Specifies the colour theme of the icon displayed on the Git Graph tab.

git-graph.autoCenterCommitDetailsView.description: Automatically center the commit details view when it is opened.
git-graph.autoCenterCommitDetailsView.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.commitDetailsView.autoCenter" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

enumDescriptions: Show the date and time, for example "19 Mar 2019 21:34"
Show the date only, for example "19 Mar 2019"
Show relative times, for example "5 minutes ago"
git-graph.dateFormat.description: Specifies the date format to be used in the date column of Git Graph.
git-graph.dateFormat.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.date.format" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

enumDescriptions: Use the author date of a commit
Use the committer date of a commit
git-graph.dateType.description: Specifies the date type to be displayed throughout Git Graph.
git-graph.dateType.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.date.type" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

git-graph.fetchAvatars.description: Fetch avatars of commit authors and committers. By enabling this setting, you consent to commit author and committer email addresses being sent GitHub, GitLab or Gravatar, depending on the repositories remote origin.
git-graph.fetchAvatars.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.repository.commits.fetchAvatars" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

git-graph.graphColours.description: Specifies the colours used on the graph.
git-graph.graphColours.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.graph.colours" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

enumDescriptions: Use smooth curves when transitioning between branches on the graph
Use angular lines when transitioning between branches on the graph
git-graph.graphStyle.description: Specifies the style of the graph.
git-graph.graphStyle.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.graph.style" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

git-graph.initialLoadCommits.description: Specifies the number of commits to initially load.
git-graph.initialLoadCommits.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.repository.commits.initialLoad" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

git-graph.loadMoreCommits.description: Specifies the number of commits to load when the "Load More Commits" button is pressed (only shown when more commits are available).
git-graph.loadMoreCommits.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.repository.commits.loadMore" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

git-graph.showCurrentBranchByDefault.description: Show the current branch by default when Git Graph is opened. Default: false (show all branches)
git-graph.showCurrentBranchByDefault.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.repository.onLoad.showCheckedOutBranch" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

git-graph.showUncommittedChanges.description: Show uncommitted changes (set to false to decrease load time on large repositories).
git-graph.showUncommittedChanges.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use "git-graph.repository.showUncommittedChanges" instead. This setting is still read when the new one is not set.

scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run compile-src && npm run compile-web
scripts.package-and-install: npm run clean && vsce package && node ./.vscode/install-package.js
